description: This Perl test script verifies the functionality of the Git::I18N module using the Test::More framework. It performs various tests on localization functions (__, __n, N__), checks for the presence of the gettext library, and validates locale-specific translations.

methods.name: prototype
methods.description: Checks the prototype of the functions __, __n, N__ in the Git::I18N module to ensure they match expected signatures
